status: proposal: thresholds and lists to be confirmed by Compliance
owner: Compliance (MLRO) owns the policy. Operations translates it into this file. Every change needs a second approver and produces a new version.

auto_approve_mode_options.shadow: System recommends, an analyst confirms every approval before the first trade
auto_approve_mode_options.sample: Auto-approved; a share of cases is reviewed afterwards

client_eta.awaiting_client: as soon as we receive the items below

jurisdictions._note: Lunar Rails' own list is not public, so these are assumptions. Defaults follow the FATF 'call for action' list and comprehensive sanctions programmes. In production these lists are synced from the official sources, never maintained by hand.
jurisdictions._note_increased_monitoring: Intentionally empty in this prototype: the FATF list changes three times a year and a stale list is worse than none. It is loaded from the current FATF publication at deploy time.

catalog.proof_of_address_company: Proof of registered address (max. 90 days old)
catalog.authorised_signatory_poa: Board resolution or POA for the authorised signatory
catalog.source_of_wealth: Source of wealth evidence for the beneficial owners

resubmission.then: The client's account manager calls the client personally
examples: Proof of address older than 90 days
resubmission._note: When a document cannot be accepted, the client gets one automated email asking for the right document, with the reason. If the second upload still cannot be accepted, no further automated emails are sent; the client's account manager calls to sort it out.

documents._note: Volume-based documents are defined in the volume tiers. ID and liveness of people are a check, not a document.

persons_in_scope.rule: Every natural person with effective ownership at or above the UBO threshold, or control by other means, plus all directors and authorised signatories. If nobody reaches the threshold, the senior managing official.
persons_in_scope.effective_ownership: Multiplied through every holding layer, e.g. 70% of a holding that owns 100% of the client = 70%.

client_account._note: The client creates an account before the application. The same account is used to upload requested documents later, to follow the status and, once approved, to trade. Account creation, email verification and consents are written to the audit trail.

checks.name: ID document + liveness for every person in scope
Corporate registry lookup and data match
Sanctions and PEP screening: company, holdings, persons in scope
Wallet screening of the client's settlement addresses
Document completeness against the required set
Ownership resolved to natural persons, effective ownership calculated
checks.manual_step: Analyst verifies holding registers where public registry data is limited

risk_factors.factor: Holding layer between client and beneficial owners
PEP (or a family member or close associate of one) among owners, directors or signatories
Company incorporated less than 12 months ago
Settlement wallet with medium risk exposure

decision_rules._order: 1) Hard rules, top to bottom: the first match decides, all matches are shown. 2) Otherwise the risk band decides. 3) An approval additionally has to pass the approval preconditions. Missing items never block a human review; they are requested alongside it.

hard_rules.if: Client, holding or a person in scope is based in a prohibited jurisdiction
hard_rules.note: The system recommends; the MLRO decides. There is no automatic rejection.
Reached only after an analyst has confirmed a potential match as a true hit. No account is opened; the MLRO makes any report the law requires, and the client is not told the reason (no tipping-off).
Analyst disposes the match: false positive or true hit.

hard_rules.if: PEP, or a family member or close associate of a PEP, identified (declared or found in screening)
hard_rules.note: EDD: source of funds and wealth, MLRO review, senior management approval.

note_by_outcome.reject: With this setting the system recommends rejection; the MLRO decides. There is no automatic rejection.

hard_rules.if: Settlement wallet with high risk exposure
Registry data or a person's ID/liveness check does not match

band_rules.note: EDD by the MLRO; outside the 24-hour target by design.

approval_preconditions.if: Any automated check is flagged or needs a manual step
approval_preconditions.note: Approval, and especially automatic approval, only on all-green checks.

approval_preconditions.if: Expected volume of USD 1M or more a month (tier V3)
approval_preconditions.note: Volumes this high always get a human review, even with a low score. Listed before A2 so that a missing document never delays this review.

approval_preconditions.if: Required documents missing or ownership not resolved to natural persons
approval_preconditions.note: The client is asked for the specific items. Missing documents are never a reason to reject.

human_approval._note: A person can approve only when all required documents are in. An EDD approval records who in senior management signed off, in which role, on which date, and the reference of that approval.

guardrails: A rejection is never automatic. The engine refuses any ruleset in which a reject outcome is not decided by a human.
Only the MLRO can reject a client or approve an escalated (EDD) case. Approving an EDD case also needs recorded senior management sign-off (name, role, date, reference).
Nobody, human or system, approves a case while required documents are missing.
A ruleset change needs a second approver and creates a new version; every decision records the version it was made under.
Client messages never disclose screening results or internal rule IDs (tipping-off risk).
never_automated: Deciding whether a potential sanctions match is a true hit
Approving a PEP or any EDD case
Overriding a risk score or a rule outcome

audit.storage: Append-only and hash-chained: each event includes the hash of the previous one, so any later edit is detectable.
